title: H33: external-sender proposals refused; new-member proposals limited
description: MLS external-sender proposals are refused (the hub is the only external sender and sends none in v1). An external new-member proposal works only for a user already in the participant list (canAddOwnClient). Preauthorization applies only to external commits. PENDING Mark.
notes: Amended by Mark 2026-11-15 (bead mimid-1wgh.47.5): the hub MAY send its own external proposals (Remove of a user's leaves, and the participant_list removal or ban to role 1) for operator remove/ban through the local control listener. Every other external sender's proposals stay refused. Document as an operator power outside the drafts.
